name: California
permitAge: 15 and a half (provisional instruction permit, under 18), with driver education completed or enrolled (DMV)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, at least 10 in darkness (Vehicle Code 12814.6)
teen.holdPermit: 6 months (secondary sources and a 2013 legislative digest; not confirmed on dmv.ca.gov)
teen.nightLimit: First 12 months of provisional license: no driving 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed parent/guardian, a licensed driver 25 or older, or a certified instructor; exceptions for school, work, medical need (CHP)
teen.passengerLimit: First 12 months: no passengers under 20 unless the same qualified adult is present (CHP)
teen.phone: Under 18: no wireless phone at all, hands-free included, except emergency calls (Vehicle Code 23124). All drivers: hand-held use banned (23123, 23123.5).

bac.under21: 0.01 (zero tolerance, VC 23136, one-year suspension); 0.05 also chargeable under VC 23140

notes: Knowledge test: third-party sites say 46 questions under 18 and 36 for adults; pass mark quoted as 80 percent or 38/46 and 30/36. Not confirmed on dmv.ca.gov, so left null.
Three attempts per application; minors wait 7 days after a failed test (secondary).
Supervising adult for permit holders: 25 or older (secondary, widely repeated; not on the DMV page seen).
Spanish handbook PDF on dmv.ca.gov is labelled a summary (Resumen), 2025; handbook also in Armenian, Chinese, Hindi, Punjabi, Russian, Vietnamese.

Speed: 65 mph general maximum, 70 where posted on freeways, 55 on two-lane undivided highways unless posted, 25 residential/business, 15 alleys (newspaper column citing VC 22349, 22352, 22356); basic speed law VC 22350.
Right on red after full stop unless prohibited; left on red only one-way to one-way (VC 21453).
School bus (VC 22454): opposite traffic need not stop only on divided or multiple-lane highway with two or more lanes each direction.
Move over (VC 21809, amended by AB 390, effective 2026-01-01): now covers any stationary vehicle with hazard lights (secondary).
Curb colors red/yellow/white/green/blue (VC 21458). 15 ft from fire hydrant (CHP).
Headlights required when wipers in continuous use (VC 24400).
Lane splitting by motorcycles is legal and defined (AB 51, 2016); not used in questions.
